segments.title: Household Energy Rebates
segments.content_text:
12 Mr Kumar Raj asked the Minister for Sustainability whether household energy rebates will continue after December 2026.

The Minister for Sustainability (Dr Mei Chen): Household energy rebates will be extended to March 2027 for households in one- to three-room flats. About 300,000 households are expected to benefit.
